title: Supplementary Code S1 for: Photothermal Nanomaterials and Thermo-Sensitive Genic Male Sterility in Rice - A Quantitative Feasibility Analysis of Microclimate Engineering for Climate-Resilient Hybrid Breeding
description: Python code reproducing the panicle energy-balance model, the sterility and hybrid-purity models, the irrigation-offset model, the simulated multi-environment analysis, and all ten figures of the accompanying review article. Includes computed_values.csv listing every computed quantity with its units and the table or figure in which it appears.
